title: Sunny and the Sugar Glider
author: Jamie Wigg
the_end_text:
The End.
Sweet dreams, little one. Goodnight.
back_cover_blurb: High in the moonlit gum trees, Sunny the little quokka meets a tiny sugar glider who leaps and floats softly from branch to branch. Together they watch the stars and say a gentle goodnight. A calm, cosy bedtime tale for winding down and drifting off to sleep. Perfect for little ones ages 1-5.

pages.scene: the little quokka standing in the soft blue evening beneath very tall old gum trees, looking up into the leafy branches high above, first stars appearing, warm honey glow fading
pages.text: In the soft blue evening, Sunny looked up into the tall gum trees.

pages.scene: a tiny movement high in the gum tree branches, a small shadow among the leaves, the little quokka watching curiously from below in the moonlight
pages.text: High in the leaves, something small and quick was moving about.

pages.scene: a tiny sugar glider with soft grey fur, big round dark eyes, a dark stripe down its head, and little paws, peeking out from a gum tree hollow, the little quokka gazing up delighted
pages.text: Two big round eyes peeked out. It was a little sugar glider!

pages.scene: close view of the tiny sugar glider with huge dark eyes and soft grey fur clinging to the gum tree bark, sweet and gentle, moonlight, the little quokka watching from below
pages.text: She was tiny and soft, with the biggest, roundest eyes.

pages.scene: the little sugar glider spreading the soft furry skin between her front and back legs, ready to glide, high on a gum branch in the moonlight, the little quokka looking up in wonder
pages.text: She stretched out her arms, and soft furry wings appeared.

pages.scene: the tiny sugar glider gliding gracefully through the moonlit air between two tall gum trees, floating like a little kite, the little quokka watching amazed from the grass below
pages.text: Then — whoosh! — she floated softly through the moonlit air.

pages.scene: the sugar glider landing gently and neatly on a nearby gum branch, light as a leaf, the little quokka clapping her tiny paws with delight
pages.text: She landed light as a leaf on the very next branch.

pages.scene: the tiny sugar glider looking down kindly at the little quokka, friendly and gentle, moonlit gum trees all around
pages.text: “I glide from tree to tree,” she said, “all through the night.”

pages.scene: the sugar glider gliding again across the starry sky between the gum trees, soft and silent, fireflies glowing, the little quokka watching happily
pages.text: She glided again, soft and silent beneath the glowing stars.

pages.scene: the little sugar glider nibbling gently on sweet gum blossom and sap on a branch, content, the little quokka watching in the calm night
pages.text: She sipped sweet sap and nibbled blossoms in the moonlight.

pages.scene: the hushed moonlit bush with tall gum trees, a gentle breeze in the leaves, the little quokka below and the sugar glider resting on a branch, deeply peaceful
pages.text: The bush was hushed and calm. The soft wind whispered by.

pages.scene: the sugar glider curling her fluffy tail around herself on the branch, cosy and settled, the little quokka gazing up fondly, warm night
pages.text: She curled her fluffy tail around her, cosy and warm.

pages.scene: the little quokka and the sugar glider looking up together at the bright stars scattered across the deep night sky over the gum trees
pages.text: Together they gazed up at the stars, scattered bright and wide.

pages.scene: glowing fireflies drifting up through the gum branches and a silver moon rising high over the trees, the little quokka and sugar glider calm and content
pages.text: Fireflies drifted up, and the moon rose high and silver.

pages.scene: the tiny sugar glider giving a soft sleepy yawn on her branch, the little quokka yawning too down below, both growing drowsy in the calm night
pages.text: The glider gave a soft little yawn — and Sunny yawned too.

pages.scene: the sugar glider settling snug into her cosy gum tree hollow, safe and warm, peeking out sleepily, the little quokka watching gently
pages.text: She tucked into her snug little hollow, safe and warm.

pages.scene: the little quokka looking up sleepily at the sugar glider's tree hollow glowing softly in the moonlight, growing drowsy and calm
pages.text: The stillness of the night made Sunny's eyes grow heavy.

pages.scene: the little quokka whispering goodnight up to the sugar glider who blinks her big dark eyes kindly from the hollow, tender moonlit moment
pages.text: “Goodnight,” whispered Sunny. The glider blinked her gentle eyes.

pages.scene: the little quokka padding softly home through the cool quiet moonlit grass beneath the tall gum trees, sleepy and content, stars above
pages.text: Softly, softly, Sunny padded home through the cool night grass.

pages.scene: the little quokka fast asleep and peaceful in her cosy leaf nest with a gentle smile, moon and stars glowing, a tiny sugar glider dozing in a far tree hollow
pages.text: She curled up warm, and slept, and dreamed of floating through the stars.
